verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud pricing lists 'Access to AgentExchange', a marketplace where users can find and plug in trusted third-party agents, sub-agents, and MCP servers. That is a marketplace-install path, but it is aimed at agents rather than general prebuilt business integrations. Missing for 10: evidence of a general app marketplace with prebuilt integrations, named Slack, support desk, marketing, and data warehouse connectors, an ops-user install flow, and independent corroboration.
